name: @git-qa/desktop
description: 検証中の画面をライブで見て、その場で判定を置くためのデスクトップ画面

scripts.bundle:host: esbuild ../host/src/app-cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=src-tauri/resources/host-bundle.mjs && pnpm bundle:ocr && pnpm bundle:input && pnpm bundle:record && pnpm bundle:ios && pnpm bundle:win
scripts.bundle:input: cargo build --release --manifest-path ../adapter-desktop/tools/input/Cargo.toml && cp ../adapter-desktop/tools/input/target/release/git-qa-input src-tauri/resources/git-qa-input && bash scripts/sign-tool.sh src-tauri/resources/git-qa-input || echo '[git-qa] 触る道具を建てられない（前面へ出す道で進む）'
